newsitem.title: POLAND: ELEKTROMONTAZ SEEKS PLN 5 BOND PRICE.
newsitem.headline: ELEKTROMONTAZ SEEKS PLN 5 BOND PRICE.

text.p: Polish builder Elektromontaz Export SA said on Tuesday it would propose a price of five zlotys per share in its forthcoming convertible debenture issue.
The company said in a statement it would propose to shareholders on August 20 that the 2.6 million shares in the convertible issue be priced at five zlotys each.
Last year Elektromontaz shareholders issued 130 debentures to a value of 13 million zlotys which could be converted into 20,000 shares each.
The entire issue has been underwritten by Bank Pekao SA.
